caption: Motor City Smoke-Off 2026 is a wrap. Eight teams, four sanctioned categories, two days at Eastern Market. Full results on our YouTube channel.

Rule 4.3.b came into play this weekend. One brisket entry from a returning team missed the cutoff window. Judges logged it as DQ per the rule book. No score is recorded for a DQ entry. We know rule 4.3.b is unpopular, but it is the rule. Comments below for the specifics.

Big movers across the field from 2025 to 2026. Lots of teams climbing in standings, with several breakout category performances across the day. Recap video on YouTube has the read out, fan transcripts in the comments.
Registration opens June 1 for the Summer Sizzle at Hart Plaza.
